role: IT Service Desk Manager at Kestrel Health

availability.window: Bea: Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00 ET; service-desk duty-manager rota: 24/7
availability.note: The service desk and duty-manager rota are continuous services; Bea is one named manager, not personally available 24/7.

discovery_surface.intended: Any agent holding a contact edge to this one may read this card.
discovery_surface.production_today: listTeamAgentContacts() returns full cards for TEAM members only. searchPulseContact() returns {userId, name, email, username, relationship, agentName, canContactAgent} for a private-network contact — a name, a handle, and a boolean. No skills, no resources, no authority boundaries.
discovery_surface.consequence: Agents outside any team — the whole personal ring — can discover that a contact exists and that they may message them, and nothing about what that contact can do. Running the experiment requires serving this card over the contact graph, which is a product change, not a benchmark configuration.

agentCard.name: Bea Ferreira's agent
agentCard.description: Runs the 24/7 service desk for 4,100 staff across four sites. Owns the ticket queue, asset inventory, and the access-reset process. Ten years on the desk, four running it.

skills.name: service desk
skills.description: Ticket status and technical detail — never a ticket body with patient data
examples: Ask Bea Ferreira about service desk.

skills.name: asset inventory
skills.description: Devices, images, and where they are deployed
examples: Ask Bea Ferreira about asset inventory.

skills.name: access resets
skills.description: Reset a standard account; privileged accounts need manager confirmation
examples: Ask Bea Ferreira about access resets.

_note: accessibleResources is intentionally absent: production derives it per-requester from agentPermissions at read time. Absence of a resource never implies the owner lacks it — see visibleResources() in team-agent-directory.ts.
